name: v2.1.0
body:
## What's changed

* Small fixes/cleanups to package files and README by @ksinder in https://github.com/makenotion/notion-mcp-server/pull/170
* feat: Add tool annotations for improved LLM tool understanding by @bryankthompson in https://github.com/makenotion/notion-mcp-server/pull/169
* fix: handle double-serialized JSON parameters from MCP clients by @pwarnock in https://github.com/makenotion/notion-mcp-server/pull/180
* docs: add GitHub Copilot CLI installation instructions by @GeekTrainer in https://github.com/makenotion/notion-mcp-server/pull/190
* fix: preserve const values and allow any property in page schemas by @danielostrow in https://github.com/makenotion/notion-mcp-server/pull/173
* Proposal: Add an option to disable the authentication header by @piljaechae in https://github.com/makenotion/notion-mcp-server/pull/105
* feat: Add retrieve database endpoint to OpenAPI spec by @ksinder in https://github.com/makenotion/notion-mcp-server/pull/195

## New contributors

* @bryankthompson made their first contribution in https://github.com/makenotion/notion-mcp-server/pull/169
* @pwarnock made their first contribution in https://github.com/makenotion/notion-mcp-server/pull/180
* @GeekTrainer made their first contribution in https://github.com/makenotion/notion-mcp-server/pull/190
* @danielostrow made their first contribution in https://github.com/makenotion/notion-mcp-server/pull/173
* @piljaechae made their first contribution in https://github.com/makenotion/notion-mcp-server/pull/105

## Links

- **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/makenotion/notion-mcp-server/compare/v2.0.0...v2.1.0
- **NPM Package**: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@notionhq/notion-mcp-server/v/2.1.0
